title: daucus insularis
intro: Daucus insularis, commonly known as the Corsican carrot or island carrot, is a plant species in the carrot family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Daucus insularis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Daucus insularis also include its potential to help manage blood sugar levels and improve cardiovascular health.
